subtitles.4.1: Central tendency, spread, shape, and the ToolPak outputs that summarise a dataset honestly — with the interpretation each figure demands.
subtitles.4.2: Reading distribution shape, applying the 80/20 rule, standardising values and deciding what counts as abnormal.
subtitles.4.3: Measuring association honestly: Pearson and Spearman coefficients, matrices, scatter inspection and the causation traps that undo good analysis.
subtitles.4.4: Fitting a line, reading R-squared and coefficients, validating residuals, and using the model to predict with honest uncertainty.
subtitles.4.5: Trend, seasonality, moving averages, exponential smoothing, FORECAST.ETS, confidence intervals and forecast accuracy measurement.
subtitles.4.6: What-if analysis that answers management questions: what input achieves the target, how sensitive is the outcome, and what is the optimal allocation.
subtitles.4.7: Turning a finding into a decision: narrative structure, message hierarchy, evidence selection and the framing executives actually respond to.
subtitles.4.8: Structure, layout, page setup, PDF export, metadata hygiene and version control for a report someone will actually read.
subtitles.4.9: Decks that argue rather than decorate: structure, one message per slide, charts built for projection, and delivery that survives questions.
subtitles.4.10: Finding errors in a model inherited from someone else, protecting a workbook without breaking it, and automating repetition with macros and Office Scripts.
subtitles.4.11: Using large language models productively and safely: prompt design, schema prompts, formula drafting, and the limits that must never be crossed.
subtitles.4.12: A verification protocol that makes AI output safe to use: independent checks, provenance, disclosure and the discipline of the control total.
subtitles.4.13: Consent, minimisation, anonymisation, bias, retention and governance — the obligations that travel with every dataset you touch.
subtitles.4.14: Benchmark each SuperMart store against the chain median, verify the PDF bulletin against the ledger, align periods and definitions, show uncertainty and write a decision memo.
